rules.description: Ensure CBS national population by religion series (id=2,1,1,1) share a consistent MaxDate
Ensure CBS live birth by religion indicators share a consistent MaxDate
Ensure CBS infant death and total death by religion indicators share a consistent MaxDate
Ensure CBS cause-of-death mortality rate indicators share a consistent MaxDate
Ensure all 2008 Census demographic, age-bracket, urban/rural, marital status, and employment indicators share a consistent MaxDate
Verify MaxDate is within allowable publication lag and values are non-negative for active CBS Time-Series DataBank indicators

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MinValue, MaxValue, NumPlaces, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE StatVar IN ('Count_Person', 'Count_Person_Judaism', 'Count_Person_Arab', 'Count_Person_CBSIsraelNonJudaismOrNonArabChristianOrNoReligion') OR regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_(BirthEvent|MortalityEvent)')
params.condition: total_svs = 47 AND NumPlaces >= 1 AND MinValue >= 0 AND ((regexp_matches(StatVar, '_AsAFractionOf_') AND CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 4)) OR (regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_BirthEvent_') AND CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 3)) OR (NOT regexp_matches(StatVar, '_AsAFractionOf_|^Count_BirthEvent_') AND CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 2)))

rules.description: Verify MaxDate and non-negative values for 2008 Census and historical population series

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MinValue, MaxValue, NumPlaces, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE StatVar NOT IN ('Count_Person', 'Count_Person_Judaism', 'Count_Person_Arab', 'Count_Person_CBSIsraelNonJudaismOrNonArabChristianOrNoReligion') AND NOT regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_(BirthEvent|MortalityEvent)')
params.condition: ((StatVar = 'Count_Person_NonJudaism' AND MaxDate = '1993') OR (StatVar != 'Count_Person_NonJudaism' AND MaxDate = '2008')) AND total_svs = 257 AND NumPlaces >= 1 AND MinValue >= 0 AND (NOT regexp_matches(StatVar, '_AsAFractionOf_') OR MaxValue <= 100)
